links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified AAO-HNS online patient education articles
links.outcome: Readability (FKGL and FRES) of otolaryngology patient education materials; factual accuracy and content retention of the rewrites
links.effect: Average FKGL fell from 11.03 to 5.80 and FRES rose from 46.79 to 77.27 after ChatGPT4 conversion; no factual errors found and enough detail retained for patient education
links.quote: After conversion by ChatGPT4, the average FKGL across all articles was 5.80 and FRES was 77.27.

links.comparator_used: Original articles before conversion; no prompt-without-reading-level arm was tested
links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT4 output when prompted to rewrite to a sixth-grade reading level
links.effect: Prompting with 'translate this text to a sixth-grade reading level' produced an average FKGL of 5.80 and FRES of 77.27, versus 11.03 and 46.79 for the originals
links.quote: Articles were entered into ChatGPT4 with the prompt "translate this text to a sixth-grade reading level."

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompt with accuracy and content review
